note: Flux-averaged differential cross sections dσ/dp_π0 and dσ/dcosθ_π0 for inclusive NC 1π0 production (\numu and \numubar induced, separately) on CH2 (mineral oil), MiniBooNE detector. Target: per nucleon (mineral oil target simulated as CH2, but text explicitly states cross sections are divided by "the number of targets" to give "flux-averaged cross section per nucleon"). Covariance: Paper states "The measurements together with full error matrices are also in a data release available at the MiniBooNE website" — no covariance matrix is given in the paper itself (Table tab:xsectables gives per-bin total error only). Not available in this extraction; would need the external MiniBooNE data release for the correlation matrix..
